pages.title: Rate Table
pages.text: A machine's rate equations, solved ahead of time and printed as a table, so it never waits to work out its next step. Use it on a multiblock's controller (or a console machine) to fit it: +20% products each cycle, on top of what its precision gives, so a perfectly tuned machine goes past perfect. One upgrade per machine.
